class.name: OcgGraphic3dCview
class.brief_description: Base class of a graphical view that carries out rendering process for a concrete implementation of graphical driver. Provides virtual interfaces for redrawing its contents, management of displayed structures and render settings. The source code of the class itself implements functionality related to management of computed (HLR or "view-dependent") structures.
class.description: ! Base class of a graphical view that carries out rendering process for a concrete ! implementation of graphical driver. Provides virtual interfaces for redrawing its ! contents, management of displayed structures and render settings. The source code ! of the class itself implements functionality related to management of ! computed (HLR or "view-dependent") structures.

method.name: Graphic3d_CView
method.description: Constructor.

method.name: Identification
method.description: Returns the identification number of the view.

method.name: Activate
method.description: Activates the view. Maps presentations defined within structure manager onto this view.

method.name: Deactivate
method.description: Deactivates the view. Unmaps presentations defined within structure manager. The view in deactivated state will ignore actions on structures such as Display().

method.name: IsActive
method.description: Returns the activity flag of the view.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Erases the view and removes from graphic driver. No more graphic operations are allowed in this view after the call.

method.name: IsRemoved
method.description: Returns true if the view was removed.

method.name: Camera
method.description: Returns camera object of the view.

method.name: SetCamera
method.description: Sets camera used by the view.

method.name: ToFlipOutput
method.description: Returns necessity to flip OY in projection matrix

method.name: SetToFlipOutput
method.description: Sets state of flip OY necessity in projection matrix

method.name: ShadingModel
method.description: Returns default Shading Model of the view; Graphic3d_TypeOfShadingModel_Phong by default.

method.name: SetShadingModel
method.description: Sets default Shading Model of the view. Will throw an exception on attempt to set Graphic3d_TypeOfShadingModel_DEFAULT.

method.name: BackfacingModel
method.description: Return backfacing model used for the view; Graphic3d_TypeOfBackfacingModel_Auto by default, which means that backface culling is defined by each presentation.

method.name: SetBackfacingModel
method.description: Sets backfacing model for the view.

method.name: VisualizationType
method.description: Returns visualization type of the view.

method.name: SetVisualizationType
method.description: Sets visualization type of the view.

method.name: ZLayerTarget
method.description: Returns ZLayerId target

method.name: SetZLayerTarget
method.description: Sets ZLayerId target.

method.name: ZLayerRedrawMode
method.description: Returns ZLayerId redraw mode

method.name: SetZLayerRedrawMode
method.description: Sets ZLayerId redraw mode.

method.name: SetComputedMode
method.description: Switches computed HLR mode in the view

method.name: ComputedMode
method.description: Returns the computed HLR mode state

method.name: ReCompute
method.description: Computes the new presentation of the structure displayed in this view with the type Graphic3d_TOS_COMPUTED.

method.name: Update
method.description: Invalidates bounding box of specified ZLayerId.

method.name: Compute
method.description: Computes the new presentation of the structures displayed in this view with the type Graphic3d_TOS_COMPUTED.

method.name: NumberOfDisplayedStructures
method.description: Returns number of displayed structures in the view.

method.name: IsComputed
method.description: Returns Standard_True in case if the structure with the given <theStructId> is in list of structures to be computed and stores computed struct to <theComputedStruct>.

method.name: MinMaxValues_1
method.description: Returns the bounding box of all structures displayed in the view. If theToIncludeAuxiliary is TRUE, then the boundary box also includes minimum and maximum limits of graphical elements forming parts of infinite and other auxiliary structures.

method.name: StructureManager
method.description: Returns the structure manager handle which manage structures associated with this view.

method.name: InvalidateZLayerBoundingBox
method.description: Returns the bounding box of all structures displayed in the Z layer.

method.name: ConsiderZoomPersistenceObjects
method.description: Returns zoom-scale factor.

method.name: CopySettings
method.description: Copy visualization settings from another view. Method is used for cloning views in viewer when its required to create view with same view properties.

method.name: RenderingParams
method.description: Returns current rendering parameters and effect settings.

method.name: ChangeRenderingParams
method.description: Returns reference to current rendering parameters and effect settings.

method.name: Background
method.description: Returns background fill color.

method.name: SetBackground
method.description: Sets background fill color.

method.name: BackgroundImage
method.description: Returns background image texture map.

method.name: BackgroundCubeMap
method.description: Returns cubemap being set last time on background.

method.name: IBLCubeMap
method.description: Returns cubemap being set last time on background.

method.name: BackgroundType
method.description: Returns background type.

method.name: SetBackgroundType
method.description: Sets background type.

method.name: BackgroundSkydome
method.description: Returns skydome aspect;

method.name: SetBackgroundSkydome
method.description: Sets skydome aspect

method.name: TextureEnv
method.description: Returns environment texture set for the view.

method.name: UnitFactor
method.description: Return unit scale factor defined as scale factor for m (meters); 1.0 by default. Normally, view definition is unitless, however some operations like VR input requires proper units mapping.

method.name: SetUnitFactor
method.description: Set unit scale factor.

method.name: XRSession
method.description: Return XR session.

method.name: SetXRSession
method.description: Set XR session.

method.name: IsActiveXR
method.description: Return TRUE if there is active XR session.

method.name: InitXR
method.description: Initialize XR session.

method.name: ReleaseXR
method.description: Release XR session.

method.name: ProcessXRInput
method.description: Process input.

method.name: SetupXRPosedCamera
method.description: Compute PosedXRCamera() based on current XR head pose and make it active.

method.name: UnsetXRPosedCamera
method.description: Set current camera back to BaseXRCamera() and copy temporary modifications of PosedXRCamera(). Calls SynchronizeXRPosedToBaseCamera() beforehand.

method.name: PosedXRCamera
method.description: Returns transient XR camera position with tracked head orientation applied.

method.name: SetPosedXRCamera
method.description: Sets transient XR camera position with tracked head orientation applied.

method.name: BaseXRCamera
method.description: Returns anchor camera definition (without tracked head orientation).

method.name: SetBaseXRCamera
method.description: Sets anchor camera definition.

method.name: PoseXRToWorld
method.description: Convert XR pose to world space.

method.name: ViewAxisInWorld
method.description: Returns view direction in the world space based on XR pose.

method.name: SynchronizeXRBaseToPosedCamera
method.description: Recomputes PosedXRCamera() based on BaseXRCamera() and head orientation.

method.name: SynchronizeXRPosedToBaseCamera
method.description: Checks if PosedXRCamera() has been modified since SetupXRPosedCamera() and copies these modifications to BaseXRCamera().

method.name: ComputeXRPosedCameraFromBase
method.description: Compute camera position based on XR pose.

method.name: ComputeXRBaseCameraFromPosed
method.description: Update based camera from posed camera by applying reversed transformation.

method.name: TurnViewXRCamera
method.description: Turn XR camera direction using current (head) eye position as anchor.

method.name: GetGraduatedTrihedron
method.description: Returns data of a graduated trihedron

method.name: GraduatedTrihedronDisplay
method.description: Displays Graduated Trihedron.

method.name: GraduatedTrihedronErase
method.description: Erases Graduated Trihedron.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: IsSubview
method.description: Return TRUE if this is a subview of another view.

method.name: IsSubviewComposer
method.description: Return TRUE if this is view performs rendering of subviews and nothing else; FALSE by default. By default, view with subviews will render main scene and blit subviews on top of it. Rendering of main scene might become redundant in case if subviews cover entire window of parent view. This flag allows to disable rendering of the main scene in such scenarios without creation of a dedicated V3d_Viewer instance just for composing subviews.

method.name: SetSubviewComposer
method.description: Set if this view should perform composing of subviews and nothing else.

method.name: AddSubview
method.description: Add subview to the list.

method.name: SubviewCorner
method.description: Return subview position within parent view; Aspect_TOTP_LEFT_UPPER by default.

method.name: SetSubviewCorner
method.description: Set subview position within parent view.

method.name: SubviewResized
method.description: Update subview position and dimensions.
